Game Overview

Santa Flight Game is a christmas game built around fly Santa's sleigh under the starry night, gathering festive items while dodging tricky ghosts, aliens, and snowflakes. Tap or click to soar smoothly, strategically collecting stars for a protective shield. Enjoy the enchanting holiday atmosphere and fun, navigating through a magical skyway.
